description: Renovate covers ONLY the two GitHub upstreams Dependabot cannot see: the wasmtts git dependency (npm manager, so pnpm-lock.yaml is regenerated) and the enstw/font release pin in scripts/fetch-font.mjs. Registry npm packages stay with Dependabot — the npm manager is disabled except for wasmtts so the two never open duplicate PRs.

customManagers.description: enstw/font release pin; the bump PR needs `node scripts/fetch-font.mjs` run on its branch to regenerate the woff2 and bump SHELL — the script header has the runbook.
